The scheme $\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ is denoted $Z^{\mu}$ in [10]. In some references (in particular, [19]) the authors “gather” together all these schemes, and consider the disjoint union $\sqcup_{\mu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$, a scheme over the “configuration space” $\mathrm{Conf}=\sqcup_{\mu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}}C^{\mu}$. This version corresponds to the scheme denoted $\mathscr{Z}$ in [19, §20.1.2].

4.2.2. A variant

We also set

$\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}=\{\mathcal{F}^{0}\}\times_{\mathrm{Bun}_{T},p_{2}}\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}.$

Here again, by Proposition 4.2, $\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ is a scheme of finite type over $\mathbb{F}$, equipped with a canonical affine morphism $\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\to C^{\mu}$. Concretely, this scheme classifies the following data:

•

a point $E$ of $C^{\mu}(S)$;

•

a $G$ -torsor $\mathcal{E}$ on $C\times S$;

•

an isomorphism $\beta$ between $\mathcal{E}_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}$ and $(\mathcal{F}^{0}(E)\times^{T}G)_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}$

which satisfies the condition that, for any $\xi\in\mathbf{X}_{+}$, the top face of the commutative diagram

(4.8)

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
